incidents.text: Consignment 1 / 3 left the finite depot: 12 pistol, 2 shotgun and 24 SMG rounds for Sella; two doses for the clinic.
Sella received the courier's ammunition. Her shop stock has increased.
Guided route paid $90 at the reached public counter.
The courier delivered two doses to the clinic. The first completed medicine delivery earns goodwill once.
Rell fitted the impeller. His workshop can drain the dock cellars again.
Rell joined after you helped his workshop. You brought my work back. I'll stand with you.
Took the impounded medicine. Six doses are in your bag.
You supplied the clinic. Neri offers a bed, treatment and a place beside you.
Neri joined you. Keep each other alive. G follow / H hold / R retreat / T aid.
Bought an illegal PISTOL for $90. Ammunition is sold separately.
Bought 6 PISTOL rounds for $18 from Sella's finite stock.
Vale's people saw their crew attacked. Release papers no longer buy safe passage.
